question: Ranjani Hebbar was associated with which of the following fields?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Carnatic Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Carnatic Music** is one of the two main subgenres of Indian classical music, the other being **Hindustani Music**.
 
• It originated in **South India** and is popular in states like **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala**.
 
• The main emphasis of Carnatic music is on **vocal music**, and most compositions are written to be sung.
 
• Carnatic music is characterized by its **complex rhythmic patterns (Tala)** and its intricate melodic system (Raga).
 
• Ranjani Hebbar was a **renowned Carnatic vocalist**, known for her soulful renditions and mastery over the rich traditions of Carnatic music.
 
• She trained under some of the most reputed musicians in the field, earning accolades and respect in the **Carnatic music community**.
 
• Key elements of Carnatic music include **Alapana, Pallavi, Niraval, and Kalpana Swara**, which are integral to its structure and presentation.
 
• Carnatic music compositions are often devotional and are written in languages like **Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada, and Tamil**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hindustani Music**__

 __
 
• **Hindustani Music** is the other major genre of Indian classical music, primarily practiced in **North India**.
 
• It emphasizes both **instrumental** and **vocal music**.
 
• The compositions often revolve around **ragas**, and the music has influences from Persian and Mughal traditions.
 
• Popular instruments associated with Hindustani music include the **Sitar, Tabla, and Sarod**.
 
 
 
• **Bhajan**__
 __
 
• A **Bhajan** is a devotional song, often based on themes of **spirituality and praise of deities**.
 
• It is a significant form of expression in both **Hindustani and Carnatic music traditions**.
 
• Bhajans are usually sung in local languages and do not follow the complex structure of classical music.
 
 
 
• **Folk Music**__
 
 
• **Folk Music** refers to traditional music that is specific to a region, culture, or community.
 
• It is often passed down orally and reflects the **cultural heritage** of the people.
 
• Folk music is generally simple and focuses on **storytelling, emotions, and daily life themes**.
